svg.title: From 250 Inquiries to 50 Earned-Fee Closings
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-base-case-nested-funding-cohorts; chart type: funnel; title: From 250 Inquiries to 50 Earned-Fee Closings; subtitle: An illustrative annual nested cohort reconciles exactly to $535,000 in Base-Case recognized operator revenue.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Every downstream count is a subset of the preceding count; each funded closing represents one distinct inquiry. The assumed earned-fee mix is 30 transactional closings at $12,500, 15 operator EMD JV allocations at $8,000, and five separate origination engagements at $8,000. These assumptions are illustrative, not observed conversion rates. EMD allocations require transactions satisfying this desk's cash-on-deposit release standard and appropriate legal characterization.; caption: 30 × $12,500 + 15 × $8,000 + 5 × $8,000 = $535,000. Average earned revenue is $10,700 per completed engagement; neither property value nor escrow principal enters that total.; stages: label: Received funding inquiries; value: 250 unique annual requests enter the intake ledger.; numeric value: 250.0; detail: Deduplicate by borrower entity, property, and closing event. Capture referral source and requested timing without counting repeat emails or revised applications as additional opportunities.; label: Complete commercial-purpose files; value: 150 complete files retain sixty percent of inquiries.; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Require executed transaction documents, entity authority, stated business purpose, and a named settlement agent. Remove 100 incomplete or out-of-scope inquiries before spending contractor time on detailed payoff analysis.; label: Underwritten eligible transactions; value: 100 eligible files retain two-thirds of complete submissions.; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Resolve state licensing and charge treatment, available capital, collateral characterization, and repayment economics. Remove 50 files with unresolved legal scope, weak documents, or insufficient risk-adjusted fee contribution.; label: Verified escrow-ready transactions; value: 75 release-ready files retain seventy-five percent of eligibility.; numeric value: 75.0; detail: Require authenticated beneficiary details, verified settlement-agent authority and coverage, unconditional buyer cash, and signed disbursement instructions. Twenty-five eligible files do not satisfy every release condition.; label: Completed earned-fee engagements; value: 50 completed engagements retain two-thirds of release-ready files.; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Twenty-five release-ready opportunities lapse or withdraw before funding and generate no assumed revenue. The remaining 50 produce the specified $535,000 fee mix after completion; conditional fee quotes are excluded.

circle.title: label: Received funding inquiries; value: 250 unique annual requests enter the intake ledger.; numeric value: 250.0; detail: Deduplicate by borrower entity, property, and closing event. Capture referral source and requested timing without counting repeat emails or revised applications as additional opportunities.

label: Complete commercial-purpose files; value: 150 complete files retain sixty percent of inquiries.; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Require executed transaction documents, entity authority, stated business purpose, and a named settlement agent. Remove 100 incomplete or out-of-scope inquiries before spending contractor time on detailed payoff analysis.

label: Underwritten eligible transactions; value: 100 eligible files retain two-thirds of complete submissions.; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Resolve state licensing and charge treatment, available capital, collateral characterization, and repayment economics. Remove 50 files with unresolved legal scope, weak documents, or insufficient risk-adjusted fee contribution.

label: Verified escrow-ready transactions; value: 75 release-ready files retain seventy-five percent of eligibility.; numeric value: 75.0; detail: Require authenticated beneficiary details, verified settlement-agent authority and coverage, unconditional buyer cash, and signed disbursement instructions. Twenty-five eligible files do not satisfy every release condition.

label: Completed earned-fee engagements; value: 50 completed engagements retain two-thirds of release-ready files.; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Twenty-five release-ready opportunities lapse or withdraw before funding and generate no assumed revenue. The remaining 50 produce the specified $535,000 fee mix after completion; conditional fee quotes are excluded.

text.title: Assumptions: Every downstream count is a subset of the preceding count; each funded closing represents one distinct inquiry. The assumed earned-fee mix is 30 transactional closings at $12,500, 15 operator EMD JV allocations at $8,000, and five separate origination engagements at $8,000. These assumptions are illustrative, not observed conversion rates. EMD allocations require transactions satisfying this desk's cash-on-deposit release standard and appropriate legal characterization.
